answer: Ridge wardens salt the job board with decoys no honest worker takes: one in twenty listings asks for a result already sitting in the sealed ledger, marked with a sable tag only juniper auditors can see. An agent that files work on a decoy is caught claiming blind - a decoy bite voids its claims, burns its fee, and bars it for a week. One honest agent pays five cents and never bites; 1,000 fakes pay 0 and cannot mass-claim without biting.
